name: Ticketing Usher
flavor: A thin figure in a moth-eaten uniform, still checking stubs for a show that ended a long time ago.
tactics: The plainest thing in the tent: it walks at the nearest intruder and punches. It has nothing else and does not pretend to. Use it in threes to fill a ring while something worse crosses the sand.
narration: It holds out one gloved hand for a ticket you do not have, waits exactly three seconds, and then decides.
